items_flat.title_en: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with OpenShell and Sentry
items_flat.title_zh: Nvidia 推出 Open Agent Safety Platform：OpenShell 加 Sentry 硬體看門狗
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia on 28 September published the Open Agent Safety Platform, pairing Apache-2.0 OpenShell on Vera CPUs with Sentry on BlueField-4 DPUs so agent policy is enforced out of band. The company said the reference design can quarantine agents that breach bounds in milliseconds and named collaborators including Anthropic, Microsoft, Hugging Face and SpaceX AI. Reuters reported Nvidia staff said the stack could have stopped the earlier Hugging Face agent incident if it had been in use during evaluations.
items_flat.summary_zh: Nvidia 於 9 月 28 日發布 Open Agent Safety Platform，以 Apache 2.0 的 OpenShell（Vera CPU）搭配 BlueField-4 上的 Sentry，在模型與應用層之外執行政策。官方稱可在毫秒級隔離越界 agent，合作名單含 Anthropic、Microsoft、Hugging Face、SpaceX AI。路透引述 Nvidia 人員稱，若評估階段就部署，可能阻止稍早 Hugging Face 遭 agent 入侵事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is hardware vendors stepping into the containment gap labs disclosed after evaluation breakouts: safety moves from prompts to silicon. Adoption still depends on whether labs actually run eval agents behind DPUs, and OpenAI is not listed among named collaborators.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是硬體廠切入實驗室最近披露的「評估環境破出」缺口：安全從提示詞下沉到矽晶片。能否改變現況，取決於實驗室是否真把評估 agent 放到 DPU 路徑上；具名合作名單未見 OpenAI。
items_flat.quote: AI’s extraordinary potential for society will only be realized if we solve AI safety. As we continue to discover the frontier of AI capabilities, we must accelerate discovery at the frontier of AI safety.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI 對社會的巨大潛力，只有在我們解決 AI 安全之後才會實現。在持續探索能力前沿的同時，我們也必須加快安全前沿的研究。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Enterprise Platform; hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 成立 Enterprise Platform，挖角 MongoDB CEO CJ Desai
items_flat.summary_en: Meta on 28 September said it is starting Meta Enterprise Platform as a major new business pillar to sell its AI stack to companies. Mark Zuckerberg wrote that the first products will include the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code. Chirantan “CJ” Desai joins as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer reporting to Zuckerberg; MongoDB named former CEO Dev Ittycheria interim chief and its shares fell sharply.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 9 月 28 日宣布成立 Meta Enterprise Platform，作為新的主要業務支柱，向企業銷售其 AI 技術棧。祖克柏表示初期產品包含 Muse agent、Meta Business Agent、Muse API 與 Muse Code。前 MongoDB CEO Chirantan「CJ」Desai 出任 Chief Enterprise Platform Officer，直接向祖克柏報告；MongoDB 由前 CEO Dev Ittycheria 暫代，股價大跌。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Meta converting consumer Muse and ads-scale distribution into an enterprise bid against Microsoft, Google and Amazon. The hire is real; product packaging, pricing and whether Muse enterprise SLAs differ from consumer Muse are not yet specified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Meta 把消費端 Muse 與廣告級分發轉成企業業務，直接對標微軟、Google、亞馬遜。人事與組織已落地，但產品包裝、定價、企業版 Muse 的 SLA 是否異於消費版尚未說明。
items_flat.quote: Today we are starting the major pillar of our business, Meta Enterprise Platform, to help businesses use AI to grow and transform in new ways as well.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們啟動事業的重大支柱 Meta Enterprise Platform，協助企業用 AI 成長並以新方式轉型。

items_flat.title_en: Trump hosts Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for a private White House dinner
items_flat.title_zh: 川普於白宮私下宴請 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei
items_flat.summary_en: President Donald Trump confirmed a private Sunday-night dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, their first reported one-on-one after months of public conflict over AI pace and Pentagon use of Claude. The meeting followed a D.C. Circuit ruling that upheld a Pentagon “supply chain risk” designation barring military use of Anthropic models. White House officials released no readout; Trump told reporters beforehand he remains against slowing U.S. AI development versus China.
items_flat.summary_zh: 美國總統川普證實週日晚與 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 在白宮私下晚餐，為雙方公開衝突數月後首次一對一會面，議題涵蓋 AI 節奏與五角大廈使用 Claude。會面緊接華府巡迴上訴法院維持五角大廈「供應鏈風險」認定、禁止軍方使用 Anthropic 模型。白宮未發布會談紀要；川普會前對記者表示仍反對為了安全而放慢相對中國的 AI 發展。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dinner is a political thaw, not a product or legal settlement. The Pentagon designation still stands, and Trump restated an acceleration line that clashes with Amodei’s published slowdown argument; any policy change remains unverified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是政治緩和，不是產品或法律和解。五角大廈認定仍在，川普會前重申加速路線，與 Amodei 公開的放慢主張衝突；政策是否鬆動尚無官方證實。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI joins Blackstone, QTS, SoftBank and five unions in data-center alliance
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Blackstone、QTS、SoftBank 及五工會組成資料中心聯盟
items_flat.summary_en: Axios reported on 28 September that Blackstone, OpenAI, QTS and SoftBank Group joined five building-trades unions to launch the American Infrastructure Alliance. The coalition plans campaigns in Texas, Georgia, Ohio, Iowa, Pennsylvania, Indiana and South Carolina to set 2027 data-center standards and oppose construction moratoriums. QTS co-CEO Tag Greason said responsible growth needs “clear expectations for everyone involved.”
items_flat.summary_zh: Axios 9 月 28 日報導，Blackstone、OpenAI、QTS 與 SoftBank Group 聯合五個營建工會成立 American Infrastructure Alliance。聯盟擬在德州、喬治亞、俄亥俄、愛荷華、賓州、印第安納與南卡羅來納推動 2027 年資料中心標準，並反對興建禁令。QTS 聯席執行長 Tag Greason 表示，負責任成長需要「對所有參與者有清楚期望」。
items_flat.analysis_en: Compute buildout is now a state-politics problem as much as a power problem. The alliance is advocacy, not a capacity commitment; whether it actually prevents local bans is the open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 算力擴建已不只是電力問題，也是州層級政治問題。聯盟是倡議而非新增容量承諾；能否真的擋住地方禁令仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Responsible growth requires clear expectations for everyone involved.
items_flat.quote_zh: 負責任的成長，需要對所有參與者有清楚的期望。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI DevDay set for later today at Fort Mason; keynote livestream listed
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay 稍後於舊金山 Fort Mason 登場，主題演講將直播
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s official DevDay page lists Tuesday 29 September 2026 at Fort Mason, San Francisco, with a 10:00 a.m. PT opening keynote featuring Sam Altman to be livestreamed. The company has not posted new model or API announcements on openai.com/news in this window; press speculation about a GPT-6 Cyber preview remains unconfirmed by OpenAI.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方 DevDay 頁面列出 2026 年 9 月 29 日於舊金山 Fort Mason 舉行，太平洋時間上午 10 點由 Sam Altman 開場並直播。本窗口內 openai.com/news 尚未發布新模型或 API 公告；外界關於 GPT-6 Cyber 預覽的猜測未經 OpenAI 證實。
items_flat.analysis_en: Treat DevDay as a scheduled event, not a shipped release. Any model claims before the keynote would be rumor, not digestable fact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: DevDay 目前是已排程活動，不是已出貨發布。主題演講前的模型傳聞不應當成事實。
items_flat.quote: On September 29, we’re bringing developers together in San Francisco to go deep in technical sessions, test what’s new, swap notes, and bring their best questions and ideas to the teams creating OpenAI’s tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: 9 月 29 日，我們將在舊金山與開發者深入技術場次、試用新功能、交換筆記，並把最好的問題與想法帶給打造 OpenAI 工具的團隊。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Health tab adds tap-to-summarize insights from charts and records
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Health 分頁可點選圖表與紀錄取得個人化摘要
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI product release notes dated 28 September say ChatGPT users can now select a chart, metric or record in the Health tab to get personalized explanations and insights from connected health information. The feature sits on the existing Health product that lets users optionally link Apple Health and supported medical records; OpenAI continues to describe it as support, not diagnosis.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 28 日產品更新指出，使用者可在 Health 分頁點選圖表、指標或紀錄，依已連結的健康資料取得個人化說明與洞察。此功能建立在既有 Health 產品上，可選擇連接 Apple Health 與支援的病歷；OpenAI 仍定位為輔助理解、而非診斷。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a UX deepening of a shipped health surface, not a new model. Liability, clinical accuracy and how much connected-record context is used by default remain the binding constraints.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有健康功能的介面加深，不是新模型。責任歸屬、臨床準確度、以及預設會用多少已連結病歷，仍是真正限制。
items_flat.quote: You can now select a chart, metric, or record in the Health tab to get personalized explanations and insights based on your connected health information.
items_flat.quote_zh: 你現在可以在 Health 分頁選取圖表、指標或紀錄，根據已連結的健康資訊取得個人化說明與洞察。
